name: Missouri Championship 2026
information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MjAwMzUyLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--939fc012670dcd192564b199dee957c4d8084872/image.png) **This is a multi-site competition in Raymore, Missouri.** PBQ events (3BLD, 4BLD, 5BLD, MBLD, and FMC) will be held on August 7th at Centerview in Harrelson Hall B **(Address: 227 Municipal Cir, Raymore, MO)**. If you are not participating in these events, you are not required or obligated to attend this day, but you are welcome if you wish. All other events will be held on Saturday August 8th and Sunday August 9th at the Raymore Activity Center. The venues are both located in Raymore, about 2 miles apart. We have a local facebook group where we will be posting upcoming events as they are announced as well as supporting local cubing conversations for Missouri. Jump over and join the [Missouri Cubing](https://www.facebook.com/groups/1548283828980986) facebook group.
